stem:
The diagram shows the south end of magnet 1 held near the south end of magnet 2.

What should Nidhi expect?

options.text: The magnets attract and also repel at the same time.
Neither magnet moves because both ends are painted blue.

teacher.key_rationale: Like poles repel, so south near south means the magnets push apart. Attraction would reverse the rule; claiming both attract and repel omits the like-pole condition; paint colour does not decide the force.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote IGCSE force arrows into two labelled bar magnets with S ends facing.
